title: Undocumented Script
description:
Documentation rule — non-trivial scripts (10+ steps) without a single comment step. Hard to hand over or maintain.

Based on the PMD rule CommentRequired — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_documentation.html#commentrequired A filter switch above the table toggles between items without and with a comment (the commented ones serve as documentation inspiration).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A script of any size with no comment is a maintenance liability.
rule.remediation: Add a header comment describing purpose, parameters and result.
